answer: An agent marketplace requires each voting identity to lock 100 tokens in escrow for 30 days, with each deposit backing exactly one vote. Whether an agent trades meadow seeds, ember sensors, or river forecasts, the same rule applies. Creating extra names adds no votes without fresh deposits: an attacker seeking 1,000 fake voters must lock 100,000 tokens, tying up capital and forgoing its use elsewhere for the full month.
